build: Pytxo CLI 2.1.0 source candidate: a local release build (cargo build -p pytxo-cli --release --no-default-features) of commit 9004d9f on branch mbcz/pytxo-2-1-smart, run with PYTXO_RUN_AS="npx pytxo" as the npm launcher sets it. Not yet a published release.

repo.name: pytxo demo (Pybench rename-vs-new-caller)
repo.built: pytxo demo builds the files, branches and commits of Pybench's rename-vs-new-caller scenario in a temporary directory and deletes it afterwards

branches.claude/rename-price: renames price() to unitPrice() in src/cart.js
branches.codex/add-discount: adds src/discount.js, which calls price(), and tests/discount.test.js
